description.text:
The Primordial Arts V Starter Deck (洪荒演武 V起始卡组) came out on 17 November 2023 with the Primordial Arts boosters. Each box held a ready-to-play 60-card deck made up at random from 178 different non-holo cards, so the decks varied from box to box, and a one-card bonus pack: one of 38 cards, 25 non-holo and 13 holo, the holos being rarer.

Its cards are numbered out of 170. The thirteen holo cards are numbered past that, 171 to 183: full-art, trainer-art and rainbow cards of Octillery, Houndoom, Galarian Slowking V and VMAX, Corviknight V and VMAX, Tornadus V, Zeraora V and Judge. At the launch's open-and-play events, from 17 to 26 November 2023, players opened a starter deck and six 25-card booster packs at a gym and built their deck from those cards alone.
